steps.title: 題目：[L, R] 入面搵 7 嘅倍數

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 今日做 3-1。輸入兩個整數 L 同 R，例如 1 同 30。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 我哋要喺 1 到 30 入面，搵晒所有 7 嘅倍數，再計有幾多個、加埋係幾多。兩個端點都要包括埋。

steps.title: 語法：變數同 cin 讀入

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 我哋由零開始睇語法。int L, R; 意思係開兩個整數變數，叫 L 同 R，好似兩個空盒。每句程式最後都要加分號。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: cin 就係由鍵盤讀入，後面嘅箭咀符號指向邊個變數，資料就放入邊個盒。輸入 1 同 30，L 就係 1，R 就係 30。

steps.title: 準備兩個變數：count 同 sum

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 開始之前，先準備兩個變數。count 係計數器，負責數有幾多個符合；sum 係累加器，負責將符合嘅數加埋。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 兩個都喺迴圈之前，設做零。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 跟住學 for 迴圈，用嚟重複做嘢。括號入面有三個部分，用分號分開。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 第一部分 int i = L，係起點，只做一次。第二部分 i 細過或等於 R，係條件，成立就做大括號入面嘅嘢。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 第三部分 i 加加，每做完一輪 i 就加 1，再返去檢查條件。條件唔成立，迴圈就結束。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: if 即係如果。括號入面放條件，條件成立，先會做大括號入面嘅嘢。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 百分號係取餘數，例如 14 除 7，餘數係 0。兩個等號係比較係咪相等，一個等號係放入數值，唔好搞亂。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: count 加加即係 count 加 1；sum 加等於 i，即係將 i 加落 sum 度。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: i 由 L 開始，逐個檢查。1 到 6 除 7 都有餘數，唔符合，count 同 sum 都唔變。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 去到 7，除 7 餘數係零，符合！count 加一，變做 1；sum 加 7，變做 7。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 一樣做法繼續落去。14 符合，count 係 2，sum 係 21。21 符合，count 係 3，sum 係 42。28 符合，count 係 4，sum 係 70。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 留意，count 每次只係加一，但 sum 每次加嘅係嗰個數本身。

steps.title: i 大過 R：迴圈結束、輸出

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: i 加到 31，已經大過 R，迴圈結束。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 最後輸出三行：第一行係符合嘅數字，第二行係數量 4，第三行係總和 70。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 第一行數字之間用一個空格分隔，但第一個數字前面唔可以有空格。所以先判斷 count 大過零，先印空格，再印 i。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 如果一個都冇，例如 L 係 1、R 係 6，第一行就係空行，第二同第三行都係零。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 最後睇三個常見錯誤。第一，迴圈用 i 細過或等於 R，唔好漏咗端點。

lines.speaker: 老師
lines.text: 第二，判斷要用兩個等號。第三，計數係 count 加加，唔係 count 加 i。

code: for (int i = L; i <= R; i++) {

en.title: 3-1 List Multiples of 7
en.subtitle: Conditional counting & summation · 10 steps
en.finishedSub: Check each value → test the condition → count and add only when it matches

ui.finishedSub: Check each value → test the condition → count and add only when it matches

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Lesson 3-1. We read two integers, L and R. For example, 1 and 30.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Find every multiple of 7 between them, then count them and add them up. Both ends are included.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Let's start from zero. int L, R; creates two integer variables named L and R, like two empty boxes. Every statement ends with a semicolon.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: cin reads from the keyboard. The arrows point to the variable that receives the data. If we type 1 and 30, L becomes 1 and R becomes 30.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Before the loop, we set up two variables. count is the counter: how many numbers match. sum is the accumulator: their total.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Both start at zero.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Next, the for loop. It repeats work. Inside the brackets are three parts, separated by semicolons.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Part one, int i equals L, is the start. It runs only once. Part two, i less than or equal to R, is the condition. While it is true, the code in the braces runs.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Part three, i plus plus, adds 1 to i after each round, then the condition is checked again. When the condition is false, the loop ends.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: if means: only when. The condition goes inside the brackets. When it is true, the code in the braces runs.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: The percent sign gives the remainder. For example, 14 divided by 7 leaves 0. Two equal signs compare two values. One equal sign stores a value. Don't mix them up.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: count plus plus adds 1 to count. sum plus equals i adds i to sum.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: i starts at L and checks each number. 1 to 6 are not multiples of 7, so count and sum stay the same.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: At 7, i mod 7 is zero. It matches! count becomes 1, and sum becomes 7.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Keep going. 14 matches: count is 2, sum is 21. 21: count is 3, sum is 42. 28: count is 4, sum is 70.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Notice: count goes up by one each time, but sum goes up by the number itself.

steps.title: i > R: loop ends, print output

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: When i reaches 31, it is greater than R, so the loop stops.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: We print three lines: the matching numbers, the count, 4, and the sum, 70.

steps.title: Output format: spaces and blank line

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Numbers on line one are separated by single spaces, with no space before the first. So we print a space only when count is greater than zero, then print i.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: If nothing matches, for example L is 1 and R is 6, line one is blank, and lines two and three are zero.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Three common mistakes. First, loop while i is less than or equal to R, so you don't miss the end point.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Second, use two equal signs in the test. Third, counting is count plus plus, not count plus equals i.
